settings.label: Text-TV proxy host
settings.help: Board serving /api/texttv over plain HTTP. api.texttv.nu is HTTPS-only and the 68K stack cannot do TLS, so the door fetches through the board's proxy.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: 3001 is the board's backend port, plain HTTP, on this host and live.

settings.label: Start page
settings.help: Page the door opens on. 100 is the news front.

settings.label: Favorite pages
settings.help: Comma-separated page numbers, kept in the index below the curated list.
